bestBets.overview: Sunny days, no rain, the track should be upgraded to good. Kick the eight race card off with a 1600m 3yo Maiden Plate. No proper speed, no's 4,5,6 most likely set the pace. TED LASSON and PIROUETTE GIRL met last start at Ipswich, less than one length between them there. Map and weights could see the latter turn the tables here. The resuming stablemate VITAL IMPACT also maps well, mind you 1st-up 1600m is a test. WEONA SATONO did enough at Doomben on debut to be a chance, here is 2nd-up and five weeks between starts, betting the best guide to where it's at. WINNING HARLOW had no luck latest, 4th run in today, shaping as though the 'mile' is just what the doctor ordered.

raceTips.comment: Sunshine Coast racing on Father's Day will be on a good track with fine & warm weather forecast, looking at low 30's a week out of winter! I'm with Ted Lasso in this opening race, he's been hitting the line well of late & did have to squeeze through a tight gap the latest when running second, suggest the mile suits. Pirouette Girl comes out of the same race & also finished off strongly, she's had her chances to win though.

bestBets.overview: 1200m QTIS 3yo Maiden Handicap. Note, sixteen can run but from this start with that purse it was never going to happen. Seven of the thirteen will be on debut and four will be 1st-up from a spell so it's a high risk play from a punt point of view. Betting off trials is fraught at the best of times, especially as most have been trialing on rain affected ground hence not as relevant as it could be. Add to that as things stand Heathcote is good for three, Vandyke two, and it could be that A & D Simpson have two as well. What I will say is the experienced each look beatable, DO A LITTLE DANCE has the racefitness edge. First thoughts, each of CROSSWIND STAR, CYBER BOOM, AURORA BLAZE, and MISS KIT KAT could be fancied, could be winning. Just so happens the 'Heathcote three' are in that quartet, market should help. Shouldn't it?

Rob Heathcote has 3 runners engaged in the race, 5, 11 & 12 with all having trialled well enough to put in a forward showing on debut.

bestBets.overview: 1000m Maiden. I' tipped it's odds-on less than sixteen will remain, and so it proved.  Four will be on debut, seven will be returning from the spelling paddock. Hence, a higher risk play than would already be the case for this class. The resuming SWAGGERING creates plenty of interest. Sparingly raced, both efforts sound. The Jack Bruce trained newcomer PICK THE LOCK draws 'the best' (rail in true may see this problematical). This 3yo won his only trial, won by more than five lengths if you don't mind. MAJOR HOT found the line latest. Newcomers IMMINENT APPEAL and BAD MANNERS have both won one trial as well. Bit to ponder, time shall tell who remains and who was just kicking tires.

raceTips.comment: Jack Bruce trained Pick The Lock showed plenty of speed to win his only trial powering clear in the straight for an official 5.5L victory. Drawn the pole on a dry track he's going to be up in the firing line from the outset & very hard to get past with a repeat performance. Imminent Appeal is a filly on debut, liked her trials & the Chris Anderson stable is flying at the moment. Vessey another to have shown up at the trials. Another 'market watch' race.

bestBets.overview: 2200m BM65. No's 1,3,6,15 bring pace to the race. TEWKESBURY is only 2nd-up but has placed three of four in these circumstances, all in former life in Victoria, three off for Mitch Goring a shrewd move. Keep in mind those placings were only up to 1800m. DEMARCAY is going well enough to go all the way and the alley gives R Maloney suitable options. LORD PROTECTOR on the quick back-up, was doing his best work late on Wednesday. Gets the Stradbroke winning Taylor Marshall for the first time.  HIGHLAND KITTY is the solitary maiden, Bella Youngberry will take at least 1 Kg off, down on 53 don't undersell.

raceTips.comment: Wide race, plenty of chances. I'll lean to Demarcay who although doesn't win out of turn is amongst friends here. Recent metro efforts have been solid & did appreciate the drop in class last start, record here is sound as it is over the distance. Highland Kitty continues to race well, inside gate & claim definite positives, looms as a definite threat.

bestBets.overview: 1000m C4. No's 5 & 6 the remaining speed. ESTRONDO has a great record at the track, 1200m would be ideal, if they are swooping look for this late. SHAKO little luck both this time in, both at Eagle Farm. This 6yo also happens to have a great record here. Alley the only reason it's not on top of my shopping list. JIMMY'S BROTHER was most impressive, albeit in what was a sprint home., scratchings have improved his map considerably. CONTILDA'S LOVE another that saves best for this venue, nice and fresh, he's a ripper fresh. Last but not least OOHLALOUVRE, no reason whey this won't be in the finish. Bit of a race!

raceTips.comment: Jimmy's Brother pulled up with issues when resuming here on Caloundra Cup Day finishing well down the track. Sent back to the trials he bolted in by 10 lengths & then made his racetrack return here last start making a mess of his opposition. I don't see much in the way of early or overall competition here, suggest he wins again. Oohlalouvre races well here & is in form, been kept nice & fresh off the latest win & looms as the main danger should there be one.

bestBets.overview: 1200m 0-55. Sixteen can run, but with two sleeps to go that is all but a dream. No need for emergencies from this barrier with that purse. Map says not too many lining up are known for speed. No's 1 & 12 most likely settle ahead. Without doubt it's an easy race to be winning, not so easy to be predicting just who will. When it doubt look to see who most likely gets the most favours and given the map is light on for pace I'll suggest COPPER STAR, CLAW MACHINE, and ALL TOO ROSEY will have no-one to blame but themselves if they do not find themselves gracing the winners stall.The latter has had another stable change but has won a recent trial for Olivia Cairns and will go up cricket score odds. Wary of a resuming MOET AT MIDNIGHT and whilst on the subject of drinks, GIN 'N' JUICE landed good bets at Rockhampton, having just start number four is the one with the most scope.
